concept.zh: 单向巡回路线与最低总费
concept.en: Cheapest full tour with one-way connections

brief.zh: fares 是方阵，fares[a][b] 表示从 a 直达 b 的非负费用，-1 表示没有这条单向通道。从 0 号库出发，其他每一站都要恰好停一次，然后回到 0。返回最低总费，无法完成巡回时返回 -1。空表或只有车库时返回 0。
brief.en: fares is a square matrix. fares[a][b] is the nonnegative cost of a direct trip from a to b, or -1 for a missing one-way link. Leave dock 0, visit every other station exactly once, then return to 0. Return the lowest total fare or -1 when no tour is possible. An empty table or a lone dock costs 0.

label.en: Price the link leaving the dock
